webmaster's ramblings

SO HERE ARE MY THOUGHTS!!
(may 6th 2024)

want to hear more?

-------------------------------

general site updates / thoughts

i have a lot i want to do with this site but i'm not entirely sure what to do first. for a lot of my pages i like to do a rough sketch for content and such that way i can just put out a finished page instead of constantly tweaking it (which is what i end up doing anyways, none of these pages are COMPLETELY finished) but i just haven't been able to come up with any ideas. i mean i have things i'd like to do (shrines, finish the collections which i DESPERATELY need to do) but i just can't find motivation for it. living with executive dysfunction is absolutely horrible and i wouldn't wish it upon my worst enemy. i love working on my site but i can never bring myself around to doing it, even when i know that it's literally the only thing i want to do. and then when i finally sit down to work on it.. i have no ideas. so it's a little disheartening but. we prevail

-------------------------------

academics things

so in school right now i'm taking APLIT and APES (environmental science). and my AP tests are finally coming up and. oh good god this is going to go so bad. my environmental science teacher REALLY likes his job and he cares a lot about the AP test but it's hard for me to soak up any science at all. i've just never really been good at it and i'm only taking this science this year because i figured that i could get it over with since it was the last science credit that i needed which. is a mistake in hindsight but i digress. he's been making little take-home tests for us to go through over the weekends and i have one that's due wednesday. so i went through this test trying to answer the ones i knew first right. mind you this is a 99-question test and i only knew THIRTY. so basically i will not be looking at my AP environmental science score when it comes out. aha

-------------------------------
